prompt.instructionsBody: Please diagnose potential performance bottlenecks, check syntax, verify index usage, and propose an optimized rewritten query with detailed explanations.

starters.s2: Duplicate records by email in the users table
starters.s3: Monthly sales for the last 12 months compared to the previous year
starters.s4: Tables with unindexed columns used as foreign keys
